name: Cerberus
description:
Cerberus is a crossbow, Hellhound's Maw, with the mythical spread enchant Tartarean Hellhound⭐, which transforms into Hellhound's Fang when swung.

- Tartarean Hellhound: All loaded projectiles are fired in a tight volley, with arrows fired as 2❤️ damage fangs.
- Hellhound's Fang deals 4❤️ base damage, and triples to projectiles loaded in Hellhound's Maw on every 3rd hit, up to 27 after 9 hits.
